user.title: Connect Octopus Intelligent Go
user.description: Sign in with your Octopus Energy Spain account. Your password is not stored. The integration retrieves or generates a revocable API key so it can renew authentication after the seven-day refresh token expires.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Octopus Intelligent Go
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in once to repair authentication and store the account API key. Your password is not stored; future refresh-token expiry is handled automatically.

reconfigure.title: Update Octopus Intelligent Go authentication
reconfigure.description: Sign in once to update authentication and store the account API key. Your password is not stored; future refresh-token expiry is handled automatically.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Octopus Intelligent Go API.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid Octopus Energy Spain email or password.
error.no_accounts: No Octopus accounts were found for this login.
error.no_devices: No compatible Intelligent Go devices were found for this account.

abort.already_configured: This Intelligent Go device is already configured.
abort.unknown: The Home Assistant config entry was not found.
